newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open slightly lower.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were expected to open slightly lower Friday in line with LME copper after a further build in LME warehouse copper stocks.
COMEX September copper was called unchanged to down 0.50 cent from Thursday's close of 108.90 cents a lb after trading from 108.60 to 107.60 cents on ACCESS.
LME copper stocks rose a further 7,150 tonnes Friday to 234,950 tonnes, while COMEX copper stocks were unchanged at 30,023 short tons.
In the past six weeks, LME warehouse stocks increased by more than 100,000 tonnes, taking the total to the highest level since October 1996.
Copper prices have fallen to a three-month low as a result, but have been attempting to recover in the past two weeks.
